component: mail and Calendar preference browser-test helpers

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The two preference helpers check scrollTop only when a target was requested and the container can scroll. They yield a frame and, if scrollTop remains zero, wait for scrollend before asserting positive scroll. The chat preview separately registers conversation-loaded before opening its pane. These are scoped conditions and ordering changes, not proof that a frame or every subsequent event wait is sufficient in all layouts.
title: Preference scroll checks run only for requested targets in overflowing containers
